description: Replace every match of literal text or an RE2 regex in one file or across a directory tree. Use when the same change must land at every occurrence. Do not use it for one unique snippet; use `edit` instead, `patch` for a unified diff, or `search_text` to only find matches. A live run rewrites each file as the scan reaches it; one failed file does not stop the others. Reaching maxMatches (default 100), maxFiles, or the deadline stops the run; files already rewritten stay changed. Returns changed paths, failures, skip counts, stoppedReason, and an undo id (live runs, when undo is enabled) for `undo`, valid 30 minutes. isError is set when every file failed or the request is invalid (bad regex, path outside roots).

caseSensitive.description: Match case exactly. Unlike search_text, defaults to true.

dryRun.description: Preview without writing. Always returns the diff, never an undo id.

isRegex.description: Treat searchPattern as an RE2 regex and expand $1, $<name>, and $& in replacement (default: literal text match)

maxDepth.description: Max directory depth. 0 scans only the base directory. Omit for no limit.

maxFiles.description: Stops after this many files scanned, counting files with no match; reports stoppedReason=maxFiles (default: no limit)

maxMatches.description: Maximum matches replaced across all files (default: 100). Setting it makes the scan sequential and exact.

path.description: File or directory to rewrite. A named file ignores pattern, hidden, and gitignore filters, and fails if binary or too large. Omitted, it targets the ENTIRE single root (required with several roots); try a wide scope with dryRun=true first

pattern.description: Glob limiting which files under a directory path are rewritten (e.g. **/*.ts). Without /, it matches file names at any depth. Ignored when path names a file

replacement.description: Replacement text. An empty string deletes matches.

returnDiff.description: Include the unified diff in a live run. Cut at 20 KB.

searchPattern.description: Literal text or RE2 regex to find; can span lines. With isRegex=true, ^ and $ match per line (\A and \z for the whole file); no lookaround or backreferences. All-CRLF files match as LF: write \n.

name: replace_text
title: Search and Replace
